plan.summary: Close the FEAT-INMA-PIPELINE-V2 C2->C3a durability hole with a transactional outbox (customer_status_flow_outbox, migration 066) drained by a Backend timer worker, make the trigger exactly-once via a job-side atomic claim, make the flow-lookup preflight retryable, and add bounded transient retry to the C4 cxapi write-back.
plan.q_intent: C3 hardening (go-live prereq): bounded-retry + idempotency-table + outbox (AutomaticRetry=0 lossy). Scope locked via interview: C2->C3a + C4 retry; idempotency folded into outbox UNIQUE(tenant_id,event_id); outbox-only drain.
plan.interview_notes: Q interview (3 answers): (1) Scope = C2->C3a inbound dispatch + C4 write-back retry. (2) Idempotency = folded into outbox UNIQUE constraint, no separate table. (3) Dispatch = outbox-only drain (accept drain-interval latency). REFINEMENT surfaced to Q + accepted: UNIQUE key needs lead_id (event fans out to N leads via phones[]) -> UNIQUE(tenant_id,event_id,lead_id). Pre-impl codex_consult(critique) run: surfaced (a) naive outbox->Hangfire is at-least-once not exactly-once (FlowEngine sends WhatsApp mid-flow, not idempotent) -> added job-side atomic claim; (b) preflight NpgsqlException swallow = silent loss -> made preflight throw + AutomaticRetry=2. Codex cross-event-ordering concern already closed by C2 occurredAt monotonic guard + StoredStaleSkipped (InmaWebhookEventRepository.cs:93-127). Suppression fail-closed (actor=='user' only) preserved verbatim.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A new customer_status_flow_outbox table (migration 066) exists with UNIQUE(tenant_id,event_id,lead_id), status CHECK(pending|processing|done|failed), attempts, last_error, timestamps, a partial pending index, GRANT ALL TO invekto, and a canonical mirror in the Backend DDL file.

The outbox INSERT happens INSIDE the C2 transaction (InmaWebhookEventRepository.PersistAndApplyAsync) only on the StoredApplied path, only for changed leads (old IS DISTINCT FROM new), and only when the event-level suppression decision == Fire; ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,event_id,lead_id) DO NOTHING. The old inline post-commit DispatchCustomerStatusFlowTriggers enqueue is removed.

A Backend timer IHostedService (CustomerStatusFlowOutboxDrainJob) mirrors InmaOptOutSyncJob: startup stale-processing recovery, FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED claim (pending->processing, attempts++), enqueues TriggerCustomerStatusFlowJob to the automation queue, and on enqueue exception bounces to pending (<max, INV-INM-008) or failed (>=max, INV-INM-009). Cross-tenant fetch is a sanctioned background-sweep exception noted in codex-context.md.

TriggerCustomerStatusFlowJob is exactly-once: as its first durable step after a now-RETRYABLE preflight flow-lookup (NpgsqlException THROWS, [AutomaticRetry(Attempts=2)]), it atomically claims the outbox row (processing->done WHERE status='processing' RETURNING id); 0 rows => already processed => skip. Execution-phase exceptions stay swallowed so a mid-flow crash never re-runs (at-most-once execution, no duplicate WhatsApp send).

The C4 BackendCustomerStatusClient.UpdateAsync adds bounded transient retry (max 2 attempts total, 500ms/1500ms awaited backoff with ct) for transient classes only (timeout/transport/5xx); business/auth codes (4xx, vendor 903/920-923) route straight to the error handle with no retry. Same stable ClientRequestID is reused across attempts (value-idempotent full-list replace).

Build passes (dotnet build InvektoServis.sln 0 errors). No new Shared DTO/cross-service code reference introduced (Backend already references TriggerCustomerStatusFlowJob via PrivateAssets=all; Automation->outbox is a shared-Postgres table write, not a code ref). errors.md + ErrorCodes.cs updated in the SAME commit (INV-INM-008 repurposed description + INV-INM-009 added).

verification_questions.question: Does the outbox INSERT execute within the SAME NpgsqlTransaction as the leads.customer_status UPDATE (atomic), and only on the StoredApplied path for leads where old IS DISTINCT FROM new AND the event-level suppression decision was Fire — so a stale-skipped, suppressed, or unmatched event produces NO outbox row?

Is the trigger exactly-once-at-start: after a re-enqueue (drain stale-recovery), can two TriggerCustomerStatusFlowJob instances both execute the flow, or does the atomic claim (UPDATE ... SET status='done' WHERE status='processing' RETURNING id) guarantee only one winner runs while the loser skips (0 rows) — preventing duplicate WhatsApp sends?

Is the drain's cross-tenant pending-row fetch a tenant-isolation violation, or a sanctioned background-sweep exception (request-path != background sweep, precedent FetchPendingOutboxBatchAsync) explicitly recorded in arch/codex-context.md, with every claimed row still carrying its own tenant_id for the per-tenant enqueue?

Does the C4 bounded retry reuse the same stable ClientRequestID across attempts (so a retry after an unknown-outcome timeout is value-idempotent on cxapi's full-list-replace, not a duplicate write), and does it retry ONLY transient classes (timeout/transport/5xx) while business/auth codes go straight to the error handle?

Is preflight (flow lookup) now retryable (NpgsqlException throws, AutomaticRetry=2) WITHOUT making execution-phase failures retry — i.e., can a NpgsqlException AFTER the first WhatsApp message has been sent ever trigger a whole-job Hangfire retry and re-send?

forbidden_areas: CustomerStatusFlowSuppression.Evaluate logic (preserved verbatim, only its call site moves earlier)
C2 occurredAt monotonic guard / StoredStaleSkipped (untouched — already closes cross-event ordering)
non_goals: Live e2e smoke (Q/INMA action + Medipol webhook_secret) — out of scope, this is code hardening
Making FlowEngineV2 execution itself idempotent (message-level dedup) — at-most-once trigger boundary is the chosen guarantee
Redesigning the suppression trust boundary (originRequestId is system-generated; fail-closed actor=='user' already mitigates)
intentional_exclusions: No separate idempotency table — folded into outbox UNIQUE(tenant_id,event_id,lead_id) per Q decision
No new Shared DTO — Hangfire job args are primitives, Backend already references the job type
No feature flag — pipeline is inert (zero live traffic), outbox replaces inline enqueue directly
No new INV-AT code for C4 retry — reuses existing CustomerStatusUpdateUpstreamFailed

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: The pre-hardening code HAD a silent-failure risk (lost flow trigger on commit-before-enqueue crash, swallowed preflight NpgsqlException). This package REMOVES both: the outbox makes dispatch durable (failed enqueue retries, then surfaces as INV-INM-009 'failed' for ops), and the preflight now throws so a DB blip retries via Hangfire instead of being swallowed. The remaining accepted boundary (documented, not silent): a flow that crashes AFTER claiming (status='done') mid-execution is not re-run (at-most-once), to avoid duplicate WhatsApp sends — logged at execution phase.

aha_moments.user_pain: A customer changes their status in INMA but the automation silently never fires because the trigger enqueue was lost in a crash window — no error, no recovery.
aha_moments.suggestion: Transactional outbox writes the dispatch intent in the same DB tx as the status apply; a drain worker guarantees it reaches Hangfire even across a restart.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Ops sees every status change produce either a fired flow or a visible 'failed' outbox row — never a silent gap.

aha_moments.user_pain: A lead receives the SAME welcome/status WhatsApp message twice because a re-delivered or re-enqueued trigger double-fired the flow.
aha_moments.suggestion: Job-side atomic claim (processing->done) ensures only one job instance ever executes a given (tenant,event,lead) trigger.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Even under retry storms or stale-recovery, the customer gets exactly one message — the duplicate job quietly no-ops.

aha_moments.user_pain: A transient Postgres blip during flow lookup permanently dropped a status-change automation with only a log line.
aha_moments.suggestion: Make the side-effect-free preflight throw so Hangfire retries it (bounded), while keeping execution-phase failures non-retryable.
aha_moments.aha_moment: A 200ms DB hiccup self-heals on the next Hangfire attempt instead of becoming a lost automation.

aha_moments.user_pain: A one-second cxapi blip flips the 'Set Customer Status' flow node to its error branch, so the lead's INMA status silently stays wrong.
aha_moments.suggestion: Bounded transient retry (2 attempts, short backoff) with the stable ClientRequestID makes a blip recover before the flow branches to error.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Operators stop seeing spurious 'status update failed' branches caused by momentary network noise.

aha_moments.user_pain: When an automation does not fire, support cannot tell whether it was suppressed (echo loop), stale, unmatched, or genuinely lost.
aha_moments.suggestion: The outbox row + existing inma_webhook_events audit (actor_type, origin_request_id, matched_lead_count, derived_status) make each outcome distinguishable without code archaeology.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support answers 'why didn't this fire?' from two table rows instead of guessing.
